services.name: Waterfall Trail Expedition
services.desc: Waterfall Triple Trail Expedition Tour Highlights Extended Riding Times (in comparison to other tour options) - Trek across all 3 trail systems along Kipu Ranch. Movie Locations – This tour highlights many movie locations for amazing photo and video taking opportunity. Waterfall Lookout – Drive right up to our private waterfall. Walk to waterfall is a moderate hike on uneven ground, approximately 75 meters down and back up. Short hike is optional for those that would like to view waterfall from top. Waterfall Triple Trail Expedition Kipu Ranch Adventures Waterfall Triple Trail Expedition holds nothing back. Here you’ll find well-maintained top of the line ultra-smooth suspension vehicles.

services.name: Ultimate Ranch Tour
services.desc: Ultimate Ranch Tour Tour Highlights Diverse Landscape – More challenging trails, 360° view of Kauai, and movie backdrops Huleia Jungle - Traverse through wild coffee, abundant bamboo forests, and tropical ginger plants Signature Tour – Classic Stop-N-Go Tour, less downtime, cover more ground to get to scenic stop locations Share trails with cattle, wild pigs, pheasants, peacocks and wild chickens Learn about Kipu Ranch's history from royalty, to sugar plantation, to what it is today Great for beginners or experienced riders Ultimate Ranch Tour - "Original Signature Tour" Join us for a beautiful and breathtaking 3 hour Kauai off-road scenic tour through Kipu Ranch. blurb: Guests return to our Hawaii tours year after year because of our enthusiastic dedication to high standards of quality and service. Explore the beautiful scenery of Kipu Ranch in Kauai behind the wheel of our top of the line Kawasaki Teryx4 and MulePro FXT off-road machines! We also cater to private groups, families, companies, and incentive groups. Learn more about our tour options below and book your tour online

faq.q: TV Q&A What should I bring?
faq.a: Closed-toed shoes are mandatory. You will want to bring a camera, sunscreen and insect repellent. If you plan to swim, you will need water shoes. Can I go on the tour if I'm pregnant? This tour is not for anyone pregnant or with back or other injuries that could be aggravated by this type of off-road activity. Is it safe?
